probe: smoke the reviewed upstream baseline against a real Zotero library, by requirement
not_a_test_suite: each check exercises ONE clause of one requirement, once, against one library. It earns a README row the word 'measured' rather than 'code' — something ran — and nothing stronger.

checks.clause: the embedder is local by default
checks.falsified_by: effective embeddings resolving to a hosted provider, or an inactive local embedder

checks.clause: the model cache lives under the data directory
checks.falsified_by: a model cache created outside the data directory (a shared HF cache, or $HOME)

checks.clause: a query returns something usable, warm, within the budget
checks.falsified_by: a query returning no hits on a populated index, or no run completing

runs.q: carbon tax and household energy spending

detail.timing_note: cold_ms is the FIRST query in execution order — it carries whatever one-time cost this process paid on it (model download on a fresh data directory, ONNX session start always). warm_ms is every query after the first, in execution order, nothing dropped. Neither field is sorted: the fastest run is not the warm one, and the slowest is not necessarily the cold one.
detail.rank_fusion_note: each score is compared against 1/(60+rank) for its own rank, not against a contiguous prefix of the series: item-level deduplication leaves gaps in the ranks, and a gap is not a mismatch. A query counts only when every hit matches and the ranks ascend.
detail.score_note: a score equal to 1/(60+rank) is reciprocal-rank fusion over a single list — a relabelled rank, carrying no similarity magnitude, so a caller cannot threshold it to mean 'nothing good was found'
detail.recomputed_note: cold_ms, warm_ms and the rank-fusion counts were RECOMPUTED on 2026-09-03 (ticket 0621) from this run's own per-query records above; nothing was re-measured. What they replace: a warm figure that was the sorted times minus their minimum, so it kept the cold run and dropped the fastest warm query, and a counter that compared the scores against a contiguous prefix of the fusion series, which item-level deduplication breaks.

checks.clause: an index this build must not write into is detected before anything writes to it
checks.falsified_by: the foreign index modified or deleted, or its rows served as if current
